description: EPShape is a browser-based three-dimensional viewer published by the chp-rubicell repository for inspecting EnergyPlus building-model geometry. Users open an IDF or expanded IDF file to view zones, surfaces, fenestration and shading, inspect object properties and change visibility or colouring. Camera and display settings can be copied for repeatable views, and images can be exported. The repository provides usage instructions, a live-viewer link and public source free under MIT. Coverage follows the input building model, without a fixed geographic extent or observation period; rendering resolution is a display setting, not a measure of physical model accuracy. The README reports testing with EnergyPlus 8.9.0 and later, but this review did not establish compatibility with every object or release. A further limitation is that geometric inspection does not validate heat-balance assumptions, schedules or HVAC performance. EPShape supports model preparation and review around the catalogue's EnergyPlus engine (model-energyplus), helping users detect geometry problems before running building-energy scenarios.
